correctness.rationale: For maximal-rank square-zero X,Y in dimension 2m, im=ker for each; transversality yields intrinsic complementary U and W. Restriction maps X|W and Y|U are invertible, giving canonical blocks X0=[[0,I],[0,0]], Y_C=[[0,0],[C,0]]. A simultaneous similarity preserving both images and X0 is diag(P,P), so C similarity exactly captures pair orbits. Products XY and YX give opposite diagonal C blocks; alternating products and polynomial invertibility of C generate four block positions over k[C], yielding algebra M2(k[C]) and dimension 4deg(mu_C). Since C in GL_m, every minimal-polynomial degree 1..m occurs through unipotent Jordan blocks. Choosing U in Gaussian binomial [2m,m]_q ways, X-isomorphism in |GL_m| ways, W complement in q^(m²) ways, and Y-isomorphism correspondingly C, proves T=[2m,m]_q q^(m²) |GL_m| c_m,d. Rational-canonical centralizer formula counts c_m,d exactly. Independent complete GL2(F2) enumeration gave five degree-two and one degree-one matrices, matching (16800,3360) transverse pairs of total 20160; finite test corroborates full proof.
